name: driver_r5
what: Default run profile for new PMU experiments on the driver runner (owner decisions 2026-11-10: the driver runner is the reference measurement environment; 5 RUNs per event set = 1 warm-up + 4 measured). Existing contracts keep their own RUN counts and rules.
runner: driver_runner (firmware/driver_runner, MLEK b2c0bb2 platform + out-of-tree use case pmu_runner)
ta_state: MLEK's own ta_config_u85_sys_dram_mid at boot (= TA profile 1), read back in the capabilities of every boot
input: MLEK's own input and the MLEK FI101 OFM as golden (amendment 2), accepted through host/analysis/mlek_golden.py / the equivalence-C manifest
image: named with its digests by each contract (build_driver_runner.sh, gate OK)

extra_repeats.rule: only for the condition (event set / model) that a trigger fixed in the contract before the data names: an invalid RUN, a deterministic counter that differs between RUNs, NPU_ACTIVE range > 1 % of its median, or a comparison that is UNRESOLVED; never chosen by looking at results

unresolved_rule: a performance difference between two conditions that lies inside the measurement spread (the larger of the two RUN ranges, at least 1 % of the median) is not claimed as a difference: that comparison is UNRESOLVED. Existing equivalence rules (M3, D5, D6) keep their own definitions.
